summary_en: On November 16, 2026, the company executed a buyback of 350,000 shares (0.4% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) at 2,395 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3, for a total of 838.25 million yen. All acquired shares will be cancelled on December 3, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Own Shares and Purchase of Own Shares via Off-Auction Trading (ToSTNeT-3) and Cancellation of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: On November 16, 2026, Yonex announced the execution of a share buyback via ToSTNeT-3 (off-auction trading system). The company acquired 350,000 shares at 2,395 yen per share, the closing price on that date, for a total of 838.25 million yen. This represents 0.4% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock. The execution occurred on November 17, 2026, at 8:45 a.m. Tokyo time. All shares acquired will be immediately cancelled, with the cancellation effective on December 3, 2026. The company stated that the buyback was conducted to execute flexible capital allocation policies in response to changes in the operating environment.
